audit_items.proof_trace: BroadcastDataColumnSidecar accepts an arbitrary subnet parameter and broadcasts to it without verifying the node is subscribed to that subnet via custody or sampling. Unlike BroadcastAttestation/BroadcastSyncCommitteeMessage which check hasPeerWithSubnet, this function directly calls broadcastObject with no subscription validation.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A malicious proposer or compromised validator client can call BroadcastDataColumnSidecar with subnet indices outside the node's custody/sampling range. The node will publish data columns on unsubscribed subnets, polluting the gossipsub mesh with unauthorized messages that peers will reject, triggering peer scoring penalties and eventual network isolation.
